label: 聊天：蓝金双气泡
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: FantasyFinal Chinese fantasy RPG navigation category tab icon, one raster PNG asset.
Style/medium: Japanese light anime, cute chibi hand-painted fantasy game item illustration. Soft rounded proportions, polished painterly gouache shading and cream highlights, warm dark-brown hand-drawn contour lines; cozy storybook game artwork matching a sunny medieval fantasy village. Clear chunky compact silhouette readable at 20–28 pixels. Richly illustrated bitmap, not a flat vector symbol or 3D plastic render.
Color palette: warm cream and honey gold, turquoise teal and soft blue, restrained warm brown outlines. Friendly soft warm illumination.
Composition/framing: One centered object group in a square canvas, with complete silhouette visible. Subject occupies about 70 percent of width and height, leaving at least 15 percent clean transparent margin on every edge. Few strong shapes with carefully painted material details.
Scene/backdrop: Truly transparent alpha background, isolated cutout.
Constraints: Exactly one navigation icon per image. No text, writing, letters, numbers, watermark, decorative UI frame, card, tile, badge or disc behind the subject, border, background scene, ground plane, external cast shadow, white backdrop, checkerboard, SVG or flat vector look. Background pixels must genuinely have transparent alpha.
Primary request: Two friendly rounded chat bubbles together, one soft sky-blue/turquoise bubble and one warm honey-gold bubble, the clear icon for conversation and private chat. Both have short simple pointed tails and thick warm-brown painted edges, with cream highlights and soft gouache shading. Offset the two bubbles into one compact readable group, both silhouettes fully visible. Blank bubble interiors, no writing or letters.
